about: Forward Deployed Engineer at RLWRLD, turning teleoperation data into robot foundation-model training sets, and a Computer Engineering student at the University of Waterloo. I've built exoskeleton controllers and AprilTag tracking for robot-arm teleop in Tokyo, on-device AI for robots at hackathons, and production AI systems at a YC startup.

experience.description: Captures multi-modal teleoperation data (Quest 3, Vive, Manus gloves) into LeRobot datasets to fine-tune the RLDX-1 foundation model. Builds feasibility proofs-of-concept with the AWS Prototyping team, and mobile-base teleop, auto-homing and state recovery for robot controllers.
experience.summary: Teleop data (Quest 3, Vive, Manus gloves) into LeRobot datasets that fine-tune the RLDX-1 robot model.

experience.description: YC S24. Shipped Red Teaming, an adversarial voice-agent evaluation suite with an adaptive attack selector on Temporal workflows. Built a dual-mode in-app chatbot for navigation and root-cause analysis over call data.
experience.summary: Shipped an adaptive red-teaming eval suite for voice agents and an LLM root-cause chatbot.

experience.description: Designed lightweight exoskeleton wrist controller with Dynamixel actuators. Built multi-camera AprilTag tracking system with 20% accuracy improvement. Developed interactive Three.js web interface for remote calibration.
experience.summary: <150 g exoskeleton wrist controller and AprilTag tracking (+20% accuracy) for robot-arm teleop.

experience.description: Designed and routed double-layer PCBs for controller subsystem. Maintained 0 ERC/DRC violations across all layers. Soldered and tested multiple SMD boards including IMU and power control circuits.
experience.summary: Double-layer PCBs for the solar car's controller; soldered and tested IMU and power boards.

experience.description: Developed and deployed client-facing e-commerce sites on Wix and Shopify. Reduced handover time with modular templates and simplified CMS workflows. Created cohesive brand identity with custom graphics.
experience.summary: Built client e-commerce sites and brand graphics.
